content: Support the user defined fault memories defined by ISO 14229- 1 Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support the user defined fault memories defined by ISO 14229-1. Rationale: Independent storage of fault information. Use Case: User defined fault memories are used by OEM and Tier1 during development or for storing warranty relevant information inside. This information is also available for workshops or repairing the vehicle if the information stored in the user defined memory it is helpful for this task (e.g. to distinguish defective maintenance such as miss calibration from obvious malfunctions).
